data.body: Moved-path disposition for retired source demoded-daffy-turnstone: `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_apply_handlers_operation_outcome.py` is deleted in the Git history from audit base 9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192 to origin/main@e539e4a65d3e7451ca3dbc4b754ba4a2370cc3cc.
